title: Oil, gas and power: one accountable partner for security, networks and monitoring

scenes.headline: Your most critical sites are often your most remote.
scenes.voice: In oil, gas and power, the sites that matter most are often the hardest to reach. Depots, tank farms, flow stations and substations, far away from head office.

scenes.headline: Four systems that must work as one.
lines: A control room that sees it all
scenes.voice: Each of these sites needs four things working together. Perimeter security and surveillance, equipment backed by a UPS, a communication link back to base, and a control room that sees everything as it happens.

scenes.headline: When they come from different vendors, the gaps are yours.
scenes.voice: When those systems come from different vendors, the gaps between them become your risk. A camera without power records nothing, and an alarm without a link reaches no one.

scenes.headline: Designed, installed and maintained as one.
scenes.voice: FOG Technologies Nexus designs, installs and maintains all four as one system. We survey every site first, design security, UPS backup and links together, commission them with your team, and maintain them after handover.

scenes.headline: One team, mobilised to your sites.
scenes.voice: Our team works from Ibadan, and mobilises to sites elsewhere by agreement.

scenes.headline: Request an executive briefing
scenes.voice: This week, FOG Technologies Nexus is focused on oil, gas and power. Request an executive briefing, and write to CEO at fogtechnexus.space.
